template.name: SJ NIFTY
template.entry_long: close > ema(close,{p0}) and close > sma(close * volume,{p1}) / sma(volume,{p2}) and rsi(close,14) > {p0} and close > ema(close,200) and close > donchian_high_prev(high,10)
template.notes: EMA(20), a volume-weighted VWAP proxy, RSI(14), EMA(200), and a prior-high break approximate the documented long filter stack. SuperTrend, Keltner basis, risk sizing, and risk-ratio protection are unavailable, and the short branch is omitted.
